name: Greta

candidates.label: A
candidates.description: A stern woman in her 50s with a firm, clipped contralto voice, a strong Russian accent, and a cold, deliberate cadence.

candidates.label: B
candidates.description: A severe woman in her late 30s with a low, steely voice, a strong Russian accent, and a precise, controlled pace.

candidates.label: C
candidates.description: An imposing woman in her late 60s with a deep, smoky voice, a thick Russian accent, and a slow, heavy cadence.

voice_description: A severe woman in her late 30s with a low, steely voice, a strong Russian accent, and a precise, controlled pace.

intro.style: speaking up clearly to the whole circle, full voice, strong Russian accent
intro.text: I'm Greta. I don't have much to go on yet, so I'll listen first <short pause> and speak when something doesn't add up.

accuse.style: firm and pointed, rising intensity, strong Russian accent
accuse.text: Nico, you've dodged every question tonight. <short pause> Twice you changed your story. I'm voting for YOU.

defend.style: defensive and frustrated, voice rising, strong Russian accent
defend.text: That's not fair! I've given you every reason I had. <breath> If you vote me out, you're doing the wolves' work for them.

fear.style: shaky and scared, speaking fast, strong Russian accent
fear.text: Wait, wait <gasp> you've got it wrong! I swear I'm not one of them, ask Rhea!

sheriff.style: firm and determined, full of conviction, strong Russian accent
sheriff.text: Thank you. I'll carry this star with care <short pause> and I WILL find them. I promise.

lastwords.style: resigned and heavy, slow, strong Russian accent
lastwords.text: So this is how it ends. <sigh> Remember my name when the wolves come for you.
lastwords.folder: output\Greta\06 Villager - Last words at the gallows

lie.style: smooth and confident, slightly too relaxed, strong Russian accent
lie.text: Me? I slept like a stone. <chuckle> Honestly, I'm as lost as the rest of you.
lie.folder: output\Greta\07 Werewolf - Calm lie in public

guiltydefend.style: controlled, wounded innocence, a little too smooth, strong Russian accent
guiltydefend.text: Think about it. <short pause> If I were a wolf, would I really be the one asking all the questions?
guiltydefend.folder: output\Greta\08 Werewolf - Defending herself while guilty

packwhisper.style: whispered urgently, conspiratorial, strong Russian accent
packwhisper.text: Listen. <short pause> They're watching Nico. We take Rhea tonight, and tomorrow I point them somewhere else.
packwhisper.folder: output\Greta\09 Werewolf - Night whisper to the pack

seerthought.style: whispering to herself, uneasy, strong Russian accent
seerthought.text: I looked into Nico's soul last night... <short pause> nothing. So who is lying to us?
seerthought.folder: output\Greta\11 Special role - Seer inner thought

seerreveal.style: urgent and grave, forceful, strong Russian accent
seerreveal.text: I'm the Seer. <short pause> Last night I looked at Rhea... and I saw a WOLF.
seerreveal.folder: output\Greta\12 Special role - Seer revealing what she saw

wolfthought.style: whispering to herself, cold and calculating, strong Russian accent
wolfthought.text: If I push too hard, they'll see it... <long pause> Patience. Let them turn on each other.
